title: Shurmer and Avi Loeb's alien bet with the Long Now Foundation

tellings.quote: Um, well, so Obby and I have a bet, you know, $1,000 bet.

plain: The skeptic Michael Shermer says he and the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb have a $1,000 bet about aliens, placed with the Long Now Foundation, an organisation that holds long-term wagers, and looking ahead to 2030. Shermer tells Michels about the bet himself, as one of its two parties, while the two men argue over whether there is good evidence of alien visitors.
